clues.text: On the Sea of Galilee, this disciple got down out of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus.
After denying Jesus in the high priest's courtyard, he remembered the warning about the rooster and wept bitterly.
When Jesus asked who the disciples said He was, he answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
On the night Jesus was arrested, he drew a sword and cut off the right ear of Malchus.
When the crowd in Jerusalem asked what they should do, this apostle told them to repent and be baptized.
At the temple, he told a lame beggar, "Silver or gold I do not have," then healed him in Jesus' name.
Held in Herod's prison, this apostle was woken by an angel, and the chains fell off his wrists.
